change_unconfirmed: The hub didn't confirm the change within 95 seconds. It may have been applied; check the current settings before trying again.
rename_hint_assistant: Only changes this chat's title in Persona.
rename_hint_agent: The tab name syncs to herdr. The session name uses Claude's /rename, so claude --resume on the computer shows it too.
rename_space_hint: Also renames this workspace in herdr. Pins and mutes follow the new name.
delete_detail: “{title}” will be removed from the list on every device. The transcript on {machine} stays, and if you continue it with claude --resume on the computer, it comes back.
always_hint: These saved permissions apply only to this conversation. Records store the tool name, but not detailed directory or command scope.
always_revoke_hint: Revoking stops the current response to clear its permissions. Send another message to continue.
always_restart: The saved permission was revoked, but the running conversation could not be reset. Restart this conversation before relying on the revocation.
wt_title: This agent worked in a worktree Persona made
wt_dirty_one: {count} file has uncommitted changes. Removing the worktree loses it.
wt_dirty_other: {count} files have uncommitted changes. Removing the worktree loses them.
wt_unmerged_one: The branch has {count} commit that isn’t on {main}. Deleting the branch loses it.
wt_unmerged_other: The branch has {count} commits that aren’t on {main}. Deleting the branch loses them.
wt_confirm_loss: I understand these changes will be lost
archive_close_detail: Persona archives “{title}” and closes its tab and process on {machine}. Its conversation stays: restore it from Archived agents, then resume it from its terminal page.
leave_bypass_detail: This agent wasn't started with Full access, so it can't be switched back to it from here.
bypass_restart_detail: Restarts the session to apply it once this turn ends; the conversation carries on
bypass_pending: The session restarts in Full access once this turn ends
bypass_next_message: Takes effect from the next message
